pr_title: Add troubleshooting guideline link to PNSE in Quic
pr_body:
Add troubleshooting guideline to PlatformNotSupportedException in Quic
Fixes #87970

issue_context.title: Make libmsquic load failures actionable
issue_context.body:
When user tries to use HTTP/3 or Quic APIs and they fail to load libmsquic (esp. on Linux), we should provide steps to troubleshoot.
1. If the problem was insufficient libmsquic version, say so in exception text.
2. If the problem was general loading failure, give user link to our troubleshooting guide, which we can edit over time, incl. instructions which tools to use to troubleshoot.

It might require exposing new API from Quic APIs. Or we could use it as text of PlatformNotSupportedException we throw from there.
Customer of the API is HttpClient and also any other (external) Quic API user, incl. Kestrel.

Given that it's nullable string, I thought that should be fine to provide something like `General loading failure`, instead of having it `empty`.
But can it be empty? Are there cases when it's actually null?

Looks like it can, if I'm not missing something.
